paragraphs: Rabbi Abba’s father-in-law. He is mentioned in Chullin 104b in the phrase: “Agra, Rabbi Abba’s father-in-law, recited it — he recited it and explained it.” In Menachot 29b the leg of the ה of העם (in his tefillin) was broken through a hole; he came before Rabbi Abba, etc.

notes.text: Reciting and explaining a baraita are distinct roles in this notice. Abba’s title follows the full supplied heading, without a new identity binding.
